newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chevalier has S$108 mln orders.
newsitem.headline: Chevalier has S$108 mln orders.

text.p: Chevalier Singapore Holdings Ltd, a distributor of high-tech lifts and escalators, said on Thursday it has orders of Singapore $108 million worth of projects due for completion in the next two years.
The company said in a statement accompanying its six months results that the group had been enjoying higher recurrent revenue from servicing and maintenance business.
"Given a larger volume of lift installation projects secured and completed, the group expects more revenue to be generated in the future," said Y.C. Chow, chairman of Chevalier.
On Thursday, the company reported a 10.5 percent drop in interim net profit to S$2.08 million on a turnover of S$47.2 million.
Chevalier's shares ended at S$0.535 on Thursday, up S$0.015.
